_comment: The places off the stairs. Each: the script that builds it (extends Place), the landing door (floor, side 0 west / 1 east), where it's built in the world (at: every place has its own space; doors are the way between), its bounds (relative to at), where you arrive (and other ways in, by name), its air (fog colour and distance; ambience profile from ambience.json), and whether the street door has a bolt for it (bolt_order). Adding one: docs/EXPANDING.md. shell: false leaves out the dark box round a place that hides seams (for places that open onto a void). entrance: a door that isn't on a landing (basement: the lobby's basement door); exit: where you come out, world [x,y,z], yaw; locked: padlock (key: the item that opens it).

51.title: Flat 51
51.chain_look: It opens a hand's width on a chain, from the inside. Dust on the floor in there, and one set of footprints going in.

basement.title: Basement
basement.look: Chained, and the chain padlocked. Warm water is seeping out under it, the colour of tea, and the door's warm to the touch.

landings._comment: What's on each landing, [west, east]: a place id, 47 (the flat itself), street, mail, or a sealed flat's number.
